📖 How to use

  1. Paste the text you want to test.
  2. The tool counts words, sentences and syllables automatically.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is a good Flesch Reading Ease score?

60–70 is plain English, easily understood by 13–15 year olds. 90–100 is very easy (comics); 0–30 is very difficult (academic papers).

What is the Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level?

The US school grade needed to understand the text. A score of 8.0 means an eighth-grader should comprehend it.

How are the scores calculated?

Reading Ease = 206.835 − 1.015×(words/sentences) − 84.6×(syllables/words). Grade = 0.39×(words/sentences) + 11.8×(syllables/words) − 15.59.
